hypothesis: A monthly long-only prior 2-12 relative-momentum rotation between 510300 and 510500 may improve risk-adjusted performance and maximum drawdown versus a static 47.5% / 47.5% Buy & Hold benchmark without sacrificing more than 30% of benchmark annualized return.

invalid_handling.non_finite_input: SignalInput fails closed before producing a decision

research_semantics.benchmark: initial 510300=0.475, 510500=0.475, cash=0.05 targets; no later active rebalancing
research_semantics.decision_schedule: only the final official trading session of each natural month; all other sessions are NO_NEW_DECISION and preserve the previous effective target
research_semantics.missing_ranking_input: if either eligible symbol lacks one required endpoint or has an invalid endpoint, emit whole-strategy NO_DECISION; never shrink the ranking universe
research_semantics.negative_momentum: always hold the relative winner even when both momentum values are negative; no absolute filter
research_semantics.no_decision: both symbols omitted so the existing Planner preserves the complete previous target state
research_semantics.numeric_convention: float division on each existing causal indicator_close stream
research_semantics.price_series: causal indicator_close available as of each official session close
research_semantics.ranking: higher momentum wins; exact ties break by ascending symbol, so 510300 wins
research_semantics.return_definition: at the final session of month t-1, indicator_close(end month t-2) / indicator_close(end month t-13) - 1.0
research_semantics.target: winner Decimal('0.95'), loser Decimal('0'), cash Decimal('0.05')
research_semantics.window_semantics: 11 complete calendar-month cumulative return skipping the latest complete month, using verified official month-end sessions
research_semantics.warm_up: first decision requires valid month-end endpoints for both symbols; mechanically fixed first signal is 2019-01-31 and next-session execution is 2019-02-01
